meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

copy.tagline_en: Switch to ultrawork mode to follow specific instructions

howto.what: 装上后,当对话触发 ultrawork 模式,Claude 会先回复“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,然后按任务复杂度选择轻量或重型流程,强制先写会失败的测试再实现到通过,并用真实界面或接口证据证明完成,全程在记事本记录。
howto.when: 当你的提问中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug,先写失败测试再修,给我看测试结果。
say.note: Claude 会先回复模式启用,并按流程执行测试优先。

say.text: 开启 ulw,按重型流程实现登录功能,要求真实接口测试证据。
say.note: 会按重型流程执行,包含多场景验证。

say.text: 以 ultrawork 模式重构这段代码,用 curl 验证接口行为。
say.note: 会使用真实 HTTP 调用来证明。

howto.what_en: On trigger, Claude replies 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then runs a strict workflow: light/heavy process by complexity, failing tests first, real-surface proof, notepad logging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode: failing test first, then show results.
say_en.note: Claude replies mode enabled and follows test-first flow.

say_en.text: Enable ulw, implement login with heavy process, need real API evidence.
say_en.note: Runs heavy process with multiple scenario checks.

say_en.text: Refactor this code in ultrawork mode, verify the endpoint with curl.
say_en.note: Uses a real HTTP call as proof.
